task: Add end-to-end tests for the guestbook page (`/`). Acceptance criteria: (1) submitting the form with a name and a message adds the entry to the list, showing the name and the message; (2) entries are listed newest first; (3) the counter under the heading shows the number of entries, as `1 entry` or `N entries`; (4) entries are stored on the server, not only in the page; (5) submitting with an empty message shows the error `Message is required` and adds nothing; (6) the error disappears after a later successful submission. The test seam `POST /api/reset` clears all entries.

faults.description: A successful submission no longer adds the entry to the page; it appears only after a reload.
The server answers 201 with the entry but does not store it; the page shows it until reload.
The error message stays after a later successful submission.
